token_service.home_subtitle: Use Claude/OpenAI SDKs directly. Powered by next-generation foundation models. No code changes needed — just swap your base URL.
token_service.home_features_subtitle: A complete API infrastructure platform built for AI developers.
token_service.home_feat_compatible_desc: Use standard SDKs with zero code changes. Drop-in replacement for Claude and OpenAI APIs.
token_service.home_feat_latency_desc: Optimized routing with global edge infrastructure. Sub-100ms overhead on every request.
token_service.home_feat_security_desc: API key hashing, rate limiting, request auditing, and IP restrictions built-in.
token_service.home_feat_routing_desc: Intelligent fallback across providers. Automatic failover ensures 99.9% uptime.
token_service.home_feat_analytics_desc: Track token usage, latency, costs, and success rates with detailed dashboards.
token_service.home_feat_keys_desc: Create multiple keys with custom rate limits, usage caps, and granular permissions.
token_service.home_cta_subtitle: Get your API key in seconds. Start with 10,000 free tokens.
token_service.pricing_subtitle: Pay only for what you use. Scale from prototype to production with predictable costs.
token_service.pricing_pro_desc: For individual developers and small projects
token_service.pricing_faq_a1: We count both prompt and completion tokens, matching the official Claude/OpenAI token counting. Your dashboard shows real-time usage.
token_service.pricing_faq_a2: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade at any time. Changes take effect immediately and billing is prorated.
token_service.pricing_faq_a3: We support Claude 3 Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku, as well as OpenAI GPT-4 and GPT-3.5 compatible endpoints.
token_service.pricing_faq_a4: When you exceed your plan limits, requests are throttled rather than charged extra. Upgrade your plan for higher limits.
token_service.docs_overview_text: VibeDir Token Service provides Claude and OpenAI-compatible API endpoints. Use your existing SDKs — just change the base URL and API key.
token_service.docs_auth_text: All API requests require an API key passed in the Authorization header.
token_service.docs_claude_text: Fully compatible with Anthropic's Messages API. Use the official @anthropic-ai/sdk package.
token_service.docs_openai_text: Also compatible with OpenAI's Chat Completions API.
token_service.docs_streaming_text: Both Claude and OpenAI endpoints support server-sent events (SSE) streaming.
token_service.docs_errors_text: Standard HTTP status codes are returned.
token_service.docs_rate_limits_text: Rate limits depend on your plan tier. Headers X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset are included in every response.
